name: BoxedChat – AI Chat Widget & Support & Helpdesk
author: boxedchat

sections.description:
BoxedChat Integration is a lightweight WordPress plugin that allows you to embed BoxedChat workspace widgets directly on your WordPress site. With just one click, users are securely redirected to BoxedChat to authenticate and select a workspace – no passwords needed in WordPress!

Features:
– One-click OAuth authentication with BoxedChat
– Automatic widget embedding on all pages
– No credentials stored in WordPress
– Customizable widget height
– Optional shortcode for custom placements: [workspace_widget]
– Responsive iframe embedding
– Works with all BoxedChat workspaces

Usage

Automatic Usage (Default):
Once you connect a workspace, the widget automatically appears in the footer of all pages.

With Shortcode (Optional):
[workspace_widget]

Custom height:
[workspace_widget height="800"]

Available Attributes:
– height – The height of the widget in pixels (default: 600, range: 300-2000)

Configuration

  1. Navigate to Settings > BoxedChat Integration in your WordPress admin panel
  2. Click “Connect to BoxedChat”
  3. Login to your BoxedChat account
  4. Select the workspace you want to embed
  5. Set the widget height (optional, default is 600px)
  6. Click “Save Changes”
sections.installation:
1. Upload the workspace-widget folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings > Workspace Widget to connect your BoxedChat account
  4. Click “Connect to BoxedChat” and follow the OAuth flow
  5. Select a workspace to embed on your site
  6. Done! The widget automatically appears on all pages
sections.faq:
Q: Will my credentials be stored in WordPress?

A: No! The plugin uses OAuth authentication. You login directly to BoxedChat, and the plugin only stores an API key – your credentials never go through WordPress.

Q: Can I embed multiple widgets?

A: The plugin embeds one workspace widget by default. Use the shortcode [workspace_widget] to add additional instances.

Q: Does the widget work with WordPress multisite?

A: Yes, the plugin works with WordPress multisite installations. Each site can connect to a different BoxedChat workspace.

Q: Can I change which workspace is embedded?

A: Yes, click “Disconnect & Reconnect” in Settings > BoxedChat Integration to select a different workspace.

Q: How do I remove the widget?

A: Deactivate or uninstall the plugin. The widget will no longer appear.
